name: Camel's Bar and Grill
notes: 3 photos: full printed menu (starters/entrees/salads/sandwiches/burgers), a late-night happy-hour flyer (discounted duplicates of several starters, skipped to avoid duplication), and a weekend breakfast menu. All legible; merged into one list.

dishes.name: Wings
dishes.description: 1 LB of wings served with celery & carrots. choice of sauce: buffalo, bbq, sweet chili, lemon pepper, cajun dry rub, garlic parmesan

dishes.name: Quesadilla
dishes.description: stuffed or crispy with choice of carne asada or chicken. served with a side of salsa, sour cream & guacamole

dishes.name: Loaded Potato Skins
dishes.description: topped with jack & cheddar cheese, bacon & green onion. choice of ranch or sour cream (full order of 8; half order of 4 is $6.95)

dishes.name: Chicken Strips
dishes.description: beer battered tenderloins fried to a golden crisp with choice of jalapeño cheese sauce, ranch or bbq (full order of 6; half order of 3 is $6.95)

dishes.name: Chips & Salsa
dishes.description: fire roasted salsa with freshly fried chips

dishes.name: Spring Rolls
dishes.description: (5) wonton veggie rolls deep fried & served with a side of sweet chili sauce

dishes.name: Loaded Nachos
dishes.description: freshly fried chips, melted cheese, beans, sour cream & fresh jalapeños. choice of carne asada or chicken with side of pico de gallo & salsa

dishes.name: Jalapeño Poppers
dishes.description: five breaded cream cheese stuffed jalapeños with a side of ranch

dishes.name: Baked Pretzel
dishes.description: lightly salted baked till golden brown served with jalapeño cheese sauce

dishes.name: Mozzarella Sticks
dishes.description: five beer battered mozzarella sticks served with marinara

dishes.name: Flatbread Pizzas
dishes.description: Veggie (marinara, jack & cheddar cheese, onion, tomato, mushroom & peppers), Pepperoni (marinara, mixed cheeses), or BBQ Chicken (red onion, mixed cheeses, bbq sauce)

dishes.name: Zucchini Sticks
dishes.description: served with cilantro ranch

dishes.name: Taco Plate
dishes.description: (3) street tacos, choice of chicken, fish or carne asada served on corn tortillas with side of beans, chips and salsa

dishes.name: Fish & Chips
dishes.description: generous portions of beer battered cod served with fries and coleslaw

dishes.name: Chicken Garlic Noodles
dishes.description: grilled chicken breast sautéed in garlic butter and white wine. served with garlic bread and side salad

dishes.name: Ground Sirloin
dishes.description: grilled mushrooms & onions drizzled in brown gravy, served with steamed veggies and baked potato

dishes.name: Chicken Caesar
dishes.description: romaine lettuce topped with grilled chicken, shaved parmesan cheese & croutons in a light zesty caesar dressing

dishes.name: Cobb Salad
dishes.description: romaine lettuce topped with chicken, bacon, tomato, avocado, egg & bleu cheese crumble, choice of dressing

dishes.name: Chef Salad
dishes.description: romaine lettuce topped with turkey, ham, cucumber, jack & cheddar cheese, egg, tomato, red onion croutons

dishes.name: Taco Salad
dishes.description: beans & romaine lettuce topped with pico de gallo, sour cream, guacamole & shredded cheese. choice of chicken or steak in a crispy tortilla bowl

dishes.name: Cali BLT
dishes.description: bacon, lettuce, tomato and avocado served on grilled sourdough

dishes.name: Crispy Chicken Sandwich
dishes.description: battered chicken breast, bacon, swiss, lettuce & tomato with cilantro ranch sauce on brioche bun

dishes.name: Torpedo
dishes.description: grilled pepperoni, salami & ham with provolone, lettuce, tomato, red onion & italian dressing on a grilled french roll

dishes.name: Bacon Turkey Melt
dishes.description: grilled turkey, bacon, mixed melted cheese on sourdough bread

dishes.name: Grilled Cheese
dishes.description: served on grilled sourdough

dishes.name: Classic Cheeseburger
dishes.description: grilled beef patty, choice of cheese, lettuce, tomato, red onion & a pickle spear

dishes.name: BBQ Western Burger
dishes.description: beef patty, bacon & cheese topped with onion rings & bbq sauce drizzle

dishes.name: Patty Melt
dishes.description: grilled beef patty topped with sautéed onions & provolone cheese, served on rye

dishes.name: Loaded Hump Sliders
dishes.description: (3) beef sliders, bacon, american cheese & grilled onions, topped with camel's secret sauce on hawaiian rolls

dishes.name: Mushroom Burger
dishes.description: beef patty, sautéed mushrooms, melted swiss cheese, lettuce, tomato & onion

dishes.name: Avocado Toast
dishes.description: grilled sourdough toast smothered in avocado and topped with two fried eggs; choose one: 'Caprese' (basil, tomato, parmesan and balsamic glaze), 'TJ' (pico, bacon crumbles and salsa), or 'Loaded' (bacon, green onions and sour cream)

dishes.name: Breakfast Fajita Quesadilla
dishes.description: flour tortilla stuffed with grilled mixed veggies, carne asada and two scrambled eggs, served with fresh made salsa

dishes.name: Chicken On a Waffle
dishes.description: three crispy chicken strips on a toasty waffle, served with butter and syrup

dishes.name: Breakfast Sandwich
dishes.description: choice of bacon or sausage, scrambled egg, cheese on choice of toasted bread (sub to brioche bun $1), served with potatoes

dishes.name: Eggs Your Way
dishes.description: 2 eggs prepared your way, choice of ham, bacon, sausage or corned beef hash, served with potatoes and toast

dishes.name: B.T.A Omelet
dishes.description: three eggs, loaded with bacon, tomato, avocado and mixed cheese, served with potatoes and toast

dishes.name: The Denver Omelet
dishes.description: three eggs, ham, bell peppers and mixed cheese, served with potatoes and toast

dishes.name: Camel's Famous Benedict
dishes.description: two poached eggs on top of fluffy sweet rolls, smothered with homemade jalapeño cheese sauce; choice of topping: carnitas, ham, sausage, bacon or avocado/tomato, served with potatoes
